description: Curated resume tip reference documents for the AI Resume Analyzer knowledge base.

documents.title: Quantifying Work Experience Achievements
documents.content: Always quantify achievements with metrics (e.g. 'Improved database query response time by 45% using indexed views').

documents.title: Action Verb Checklist for Tech Resumes
documents.content: Use strong action verbs like 'Architected', 'Implemented', 'Optimized', 'Automated', 'Spearheaded', and 'Refactored' at the start of bullet points.

documents.title: Optimizing Resumes for ATS Scanners
documents.content: Avoid complex table layouts or graphic elements. Ensure core technical skills appear in a dedicated Technical Skills section.

documents.title: Crafting a Powerful Executive Summary
documents.content: Limit your resume summary to 2-3 concise sentences detailing your career focus, total years of experience, and primary tech stack.

documents.title: High-Impact Project Section Format
documents.content: Format portfolio projects with a short title, target goal, tech stack used, and live demo / GitHub link.
